execution.publication: Existing FoundationPublicationStore CAS and durable canonical Promotion only; never direct pointer writes

execution.source_time: Use SAP clock per cycle/statement window; observed UTC offset is not IANA timezone accreditation
execution.recovery: Reuse only complete hash-verified statements. An interrupted cursor cannot resume the same SAP snapshot. Explicit native-key prefix reconciliation retains original failure and does not certify the full business window.
execution.rollback: No rollback needed before publication; retain all previous Foundation/Reference snapshots. Use canonical journal/CAS rollback only after an actual promotion.
execution.frequency_candidate: MANUAL_ONLY; choose a schedule after published-cycle cost, source timezone and per-domain late-change semantics are accredited
